'''Grunk''' was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] that was active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he tried to capture [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] during their journey through the [[Death Canyon]] .

This attempt failed and Grunk flew against a rock after a duel with Obi-Wan. It was not known whether Grunk was slain.
